planets.name: TOI-519 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-519 with a 1.27-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-519 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-519. Its orbit and size follow Kagetani et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
